Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the tracking of prevailing wage surveys.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring the tracking of prevailing wagesurveys; and amending RCW 39.12.026.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 39.12.026 and 2003 c 363 s 206 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In establishing the prevailing rate of wage under RCW39.12.010, 39.12.015, and 39.12.020, all data collected by thedepartment may be used only in the county for which the work wasperformed. (2) This section applies only to prevailing wage surveys initiatedon or after August 1, 2003. (3) The department shall keep track of the number of wage surveysthe department sends and the number of responses the departmentreceives for each of the following categories: (a) Individual contractors; (b) Employers that directly employ and supervise workers asemployees in building service maintenance, in shipbuilding or shiprepair, in the manufacture of nonstandard items produced for public p. 1 HB 2692works projects, and in the production and delivery of gravel, concrete,asphalt, crushed rock, sand, and other similar materials; (c) Labor unions submitting wage and hour data on behalf ofcontractors and employers who are signatory to the unions' collectivebargaining agreements covering the surveyed trade or occupation; and (d) Interested parties providing wage and hour data by trade andoccupation from certified payroll records or from hours reported onaffidavits of wages paid.
